columns.description: the units of the observation value
columns.value_description:
commonsense evidence: DESCRIPTION + VALUE + UNITS could be a fact:
e.g.: body height of patient xxx is 166.03 cm:
body height is in DESCRIPTION 
166.03 is in VALUE 
cm is in UNITS
